#!/bin/bash
# web-access.sh - Web access with fallback priority
# Priority: agent-browser → Brave Search → DuckDuckGo

URL="$1"
MODE="${2:-fetch}"  # fetch, search, or interactive
QUERY="$3"

log() {
    echo "[web-access] $1" >&2
}

# Priority 1: agent-browser (for interactive tasks or specific URLs)

    if command -v agent-browser &> /dev/null; then
